sih_project_recommended_schemes.overview: These 7 schemes are recommended for your SIH MVP because they have clear, documented parameters, cover different project cost tiers, and are actively operational. Start with these for your prototype, then expand.

schemes.scheme_name: PM MUDRA Yojana (Pradhan Mantri Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency)
schemes.why_include: Most documented central scheme, clear tier structure, high accessibility, no collateral, best for small businesses under ₹10 lakh
schemes.project_cost_range: Flexible (no fixed cap, but loans in three tiers: 50K, 5L, 10L)
schemes.margin_requirement: Varies by lending bank (typically 10-20%, not fixed by scheme)
schemes.data_verification_difficulty: EASY - fully documented on mudra.org.in and SIDBI portal
schemes.documentation_status: ✓ Verified - use this for your calculator first

schemes.why_include: Clear tiered structure with subsidy, good for projects ₹10L to ₹25L, well-documented by KVIC
schemes.subsidy: 15% to 35% of project cost (credit-linked subsidy via KVIC)
schemes.documentation_status: ✓ Verified - second priority for your calculator

schemes.why_include: Targets SC/ST/Women specifically, clear ₹10L to ₹1Cr range, 25% margin support, well-documented
schemes.target_group: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs (greenfield/new project only)
schemes.interest_rate: Bank MCLR + 3% + tenor premium (ceiling: SBI base + 1.75%)
schemes.moratorium_months: 18 months (for project-based businesses like dairy, agriculture, manufacturing)

schemes.scheme_name: GSCDC Margin Money Loan Scheme (Gujarat Scheduled Caste Development Corporation)
schemes.why_include: State-level, SC-targeted, closest structural match to problem statement's 'margin money + concessional loan' model. Essential for Mehsana demo.
schemes.project_cost_range: Flexible (typically small to medium projects, ₹50K to ₹20L range based on NABARD norms)
schemes.margin_requirement: Varies (to be confirmed from GSCDC GR, likely 10-15%)
schemes.max_loan_amount: To be confirmed from GSCDC GR (typically ₹5-20L for small enterprises)
schemes.interest_rate: Concessional (typically 4-6% below bank rate, to be confirmed)
schemes.subsidy: Interest subsidy or margin money grant (to be confirmed)
schemes.collateral_required: Conditional (RBI priority sector norms, typically required for loans > ₹25K)
schemes.data_verification_difficulty: MEDIUM - need to contact GSCDC Mehsana office directly for exact GR
schemes.official_contact: GSCDC District Office, Mehsana | Phone: TBD | Email: TBD
schemes.documentation_status: ⚠ NEEDS VERIFICATION - highest priority for Mehsana demo credibility

schemes.scheme_name: GBCDC Small Business Scheme (Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation)
schemes.why_include: OBC/SEBC-targeted state scheme, small project focus (₹2L cap), good for retail/service businesses in Mehsana
schemes.subsidy: Interest subsidy or margin support (to be confirmed)
schemes.data_verification_difficulty: MEDIUM - contact GBCDC Mehsana for exact parameters
schemes.documentation_status: ⚠ NEEDS VERIFICATION - check for current operative GR

schemes.why_include: Mehsana's Dudhsagar Dairy ecosystem is massive — this scheme refinances cooperative dairy societies directly, making it highly relevant for your demo
schemes.target_group: Dairy cooperative societies, milk producers' unions
schemes.interest_rate: NABARD refinance rate (typically lower than retail banks, ~5-6%)
best_for_businesses: Dairy collection centre (if part of registered society)
schemes.data_verification_difficulty: MEDIUM - check NABARD regional office, Ahmedabad
schemes.documentation_status: ✓ Semi-verified - NABARD rates are public, but need scheme-specific docs

schemes.why_include: State subsidy scheme for new/existing MSMEs, stacks with bank loans, good showcase of multi-layer financing
schemes.target_group: Registered MSMEs (Udyam-registered), varies by MSME category
schemes.project_cost_range: Flexible (no fixed cap, applicable to investment in plant/machinery, equipment)
schemes.margin_requirement: Not applicable (subsidy on top of bank loan)
schemes.loan_coverage: Bank loan is separate; this scheme subsidizes interest/capital
schemes.max_loan_amount: N/A — this is a subsidy, not a loan
schemes.interest_rate: Base loan from bank + interest subsidy (typically 1-3% subsidy)
schemes.subsidy: Capital investment subsidy (%, ceilings vary by taluka category) + SGST reimbursement
best_for_businesses: Any MSME in Mehsana buying new equipment/machinery
schemes.documentation_status: ✓ Verified - good add-on layer to show subsidy stacking

phase_1_mvp.description: Build your Scheme Router with these 3 schemes first
phase_1_mvp.reason: These are fully documented, centrally administered, have clear parameters. Your calculator will work flawlessly with these.

phase_2_demo.description: Add state schemes for SIH demo credibility
phase_2_demo.reason: These are Mehsana-specific, make your demo locally relevant.
phase_2_demo.effort: 1 week (assuming you get GRs from GSCDC/GBCDC offices)

phase_3_extension.reason: Show that your router can handle different financing models (cooperative, subsidy-stacking).

critical_reminders.note_1: Do NOT hardcode interest rates from secondary websites. Always verify against the official scheme GR or ministry portal.
critical_reminders.note_2: GSCDC and GBCDC schemes are your secret weapon for an SIH demo — they show deep local knowledge. Prioritize getting their GRs this week.
critical_reminders.note_3: The problem statement's exact ₹1.40L / ₹50L tiers still don't match any scheme exactly. Ask GSCDC/GBCDC or DIC Mehsana directly if those specific tiers exist in any state scheme GR.
critical_reminders.note_4: Your calculator's biggest credibility problem will be 'How did you get these numbers?' — always be ready to cite the GR date and source in your SIH presentation.
